Column key

T1–T3: target priority. Cl: cloak (Y/N). Init: initiative. Gun: guns. Arm: armour. Dmg: damage. M/C/E: Metal, Crystal, Eonium costs. A/C and D/C: armour and damage relative to cost. E/R and ETA use the catalogue values.

Fi: Fighter · Co: Corvette · Fr: Frigate · De: Destroyer · Cr: Cruiser · Bs: Battleship · Ro: Asteroids · St: Structures.
